name: Snufflenose Owner's Manual
summary: In Ratchet, Mebok Mizzyrix keeps Snufflenose Owner's Manual beside him. Marwig Rustbolt of Snuff Inc. wrote the booklet to explain how to send a trained Snufflenose Gopher after Blueleaf Tubers in Razorfen Kraul.

sections.title: A Goblin's Operating Guide
sections.body: Marwig Rustbolt, owner of Snuff Inc., wrote a guide to handling the company's trained snufflenose gophers. Their keen noses can detect Blueleaf Tubers buried underground from fifty paces away. The manual explains how to release a gopher from a ventilated crate and guide its rooting with a command stick. Prospectors direct it through Razorfen Kraul's thorns and quilboar tunnels to find the tubers.

faq.q: What is the purpose of the Snufflenose Owner's Manual?
faq.answer: The manual explains how to release Mebok Mizzyrix's trained snufflenose gopher from its crate and guide it with a command stick to find Blueleaf Tubers in Razorfen Kraul.

faq.q: Where can I find the manual?
faq.answer: You can find the manual in Ratchet, beside Mebok Mizzyrix and the crates and command sticks used to gather tubers.

faq.q: Why are snufflenose gophers needed to find Blueleaf Tubers?
aliases: can i find tubers without gophers
faq.answer: Blueleaf Tubers lie buried deep in Razorfen Kraul, where they are nearly impossible for humanoids to spot. A trained gopher can smell one from fifty paces away.
Marwig Rustbolt, owner of Snuff Inc., signed the manual. He wrote it to teach new owners how to feed, walk and command their gophers with the patented command stick.

angles.text: The manual explains how to retrieve Blueleaf Tubers, an underground root prized as a rare delicacy by gourmands and traders across Azeroth.
